content:
Interview Experience 
 
 
 
 
 Tushar Zalte 
 
 31.08.2023 
 Final Year Electrical (2020-24) 

INTRODUCTION 
 
 Role - Associate Application Developer 
 
 Organization - Oracle Financial Software Services Ltd. 
 Eligibility: Circuit Branches (CS, IT, EXTC, Electronics, 
 Electrical) 
 CGPA - 7+ | No Backlogs | 12th - 70% | 10th - 70% 
 Location - Mumbai / Pune / Bangalore / Chennai 
 Salary - 19.2 CTC ( Base-14.5 + 20K Stocks(25% redemption every year) + PF ) 
 
 
 HIRING WORKFLOW 
 
 1. Online Test 
 2. PPT ( TPO Seminar Hall ) 
 3. Technical Interview 
 4. Tech + HR Interview 
 
 ONLINE TEST 
 
 Hackerrank Platform (Online)| 5:00 PM 10/8/23 | 100 mins | 22 Questions 
 
 1. Coding (1): Leetcode – Medium -> link 
 2. Aptitude (10) 
 3. Grammar (10) 
 4. REST API (1) 
 
 Tip: Don’t make silly mistakes in Aptitude & Grammar Coz that factor 
 influences score I did solve the coding question (All test cases passed) 
 with Aptitude & Grammar. 
 55 Students were shortlisted for 2 Roles (40 + 15). 

TECHNICAL INTERVIEW 
 
 TPO (Offline)| (around 1 hr) 
 
 He started with the standard question “Tell me About Yourself.” 
 
 Interviewers went through my resume and asked me everything about my recent 
 projects. 
 He asked me about REST API (mentioned in resume). 
 Also asked how you implement Social google login feature (which is mention in my 
 project). 
 He asked do you have knowledge of Java and python. (I said no) 
 Then he asked OOPs concept. 
 1) What is OOPs? 
 2) Difference between interface class and abstract class? 
 3) What is inheritance? 
 4) What is Method Overriding ? 
 5) Difference between C and C++. 
 
 Then he asked do you have knowledge of Data Structure. 
 1) Implement Stack using array. 
 2) Linked List Vs Array ? Which is better & Why ? 
 3) Which data Structure is better if you want to insert element in the middle? 
 (array or linked List). 
 4) What is Circular Linked List and Doubly Linked List and implement them? 
 5) Find the index of element in sorted array. (I started with linear search and then 
 apply binary search.) 
 6) Given an array, count the frequency of each element. 
 
 After that he want to test my SQL knowledge. 
 1) What are Joins? 
 2) What are different types of joins? 
 3) What is Self Join? 
 4) Then he gave a query of Self Join which is tricky one. 
 5) Difference between Delete and Truncate Command. 
 
 Lastly, the interviewer asked If I had any questions. 
 (PS. Always ask 1-2 questions that show that you’re interested in the company.) 
 
 Note:- Make sure you are confident talking about the content on your resume. 

TECHNICAL + HR INTERVIEW 
 
 TPO (Offline) | 35-40 Mins 
 
 First he asked How Electrical Engineering is going on? 
 
 Then He started with the standard question “Tell me About Yourself”. 
 Then he told me explain any one project in detail And also asked some questions 
 based on Project. 
 As my project is related to web development he asked, 
 1) How you integrate API call? 
 2) How client side and server side work? 
 
 Then he said design your project I was confused at that moment. (question is 
 basically related to Low level design). 
 So, I explained project and also draw the structure of the project. (like how frontend 
 and backend interact with each other) And also explained Low level design. 
 
 Then Interviewers moved to DBMS and asked 
 1) What is transaction? 
 
 Then he gave me one scenario, Assume if your wife has your all the bank related 
 details and suppose she and you are making transaction at same time like (she 
 using UPI and you do transaction through ATM) Then which transaction is 
 occurred first? 
 (Then I answered it is special case that we should handle and also transaction 
 should maintain ACID properties. Interviewer satisfy with that) 
 
 2) Explain Acid Properties. 
 
 
 Then He asked what are your Hobbies? 
 
 Lastly, the interviewer asked If I had any questions 
 
 RESULT 
 
 19 Students were selected and luckily I was one of them 
 
 ADVICE: Always read company archives on gfg and coc drive (and practice) 

REFERENCE: 
 
 DSA: 
 Youtube channels that I followed: 
 Abdul Bari DAA , 
 Take u Forward, 
 Aditya Verma (the GOD of DP, also referred to his other playlists of recursion, sliding 
 Window ,binary search, stacks) 
 
 Also I follow Love babbar’s 450 sheet and striver 180 sheet 
 
 OOPs: 
 Love Babbar's Cheatsheet: Covers all the important topics 
 
 For OOPS, be very clear with the 4 pillars, their analogies and real life 
 examples. OOPS real world 
 
 I followed Prof Abdul Bari’s course on C++ which had oops. 
 
 DBMS: 
 DBMS Gate Smashers Playlist 
 Database Indexing 
 Normalization 
 SQL practice on Hackerrank and leetcode 
 Quick Revision 
 
 APTITUDE: 
 IndiaBix 
 
 SYESTEM DESIGN: 
 Low Level Design 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 ALL THE BEST!! 
 
 (If you have any queries, drop an email at tusharzalteidol75@gmail.com)
